meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: State co-operative banks that keep accounts with the RBI: deposits, borrowings, loans and investments, every month (also report 28 in the Bulletin)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 322 (data provider DP3), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (5 values, e.g. 2.2.2 Borrowings from Banks on 2012-11-02; 2.2.2 Borrowings from Banks on 2015-09-04; 2.2.2 Borrowings from Banks on 2016-08-26).
